ownerDecision.inheritedFrom: STU-08/STU-09; no credential bypass or substitute DB

contracts.ownership: Server-derived studentProfileId, shared immutable first read_at across accounts/devices
contracts.mutation: CSRF + UUID Idempotency-Key + empty body,204 including replay; missing/foreign/archived/expired item404
contracts.count: One COUNT on notification table; no JOIN or body/title/payload loading
contracts.retention: 500 active entries,90x24h TTL. Overflow/expired archived, never resurrected; archive/source retained for dedupe, no physical purge

creation.service: NotificationService.create(tx, canonicalSourceId), never arbitrary controller input
creation.producer: Transaction-local business triggers enqueue StudentNotificationSource; worker projector calls service; inbox+source receipt commit together
events: Existing lesson time change or transition to CANCELLED
Teacher publication of confirmed eight-lesson report
Director-confirmed receipt plus approved distribution, scoped through recipient subscription (not payer/contact)
7/3 calendar-day expiry, pupil timezone, finite valid_to and enabled profile
creation.deduplication: Source event_key unique; inbox id=source id; same per-student lock as read-all
creation.privacy: Public fixed text and minimal owned entity ids; no internal notes, amounts, grades, report/homework contents or capability URLs

worker.delivery: Up to20 events per poll, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, one DB-only transaction per event; safe retry after rollback
worker.maintenance: Every60s, up to50 expiry sources and50 pupils for expired archive; list/count enforceTTL even if worker stopped
worker.lifecycle: Independent background task, single task per process, no finance/PDF poll blocking, stop/drain
worker.missedDay: No retrospective7/3-day notice after a whole threshold day was missed
